statement: Descriptive only: no bar, no verdict. Entry and motion are UNCHANGED and UNPHYSICAL: squads still walk through tissue one voxel per tick carrying their whole dose. Nothing here is a claim about delivery in a patient.

sources.budget_mg: Gliadel label / NICE TA121: at most 8 wafers x 7.7 mg BCNU = 61.6 mg, the clinical maximum (grounding report, delivery ledger). A per-case cap, never scaled by perceived volume and never tuned.
sources.d_star_cm2_s: Free TMA+ diffusivity 1.311e-5 cm2/s at 37 C (Vorisek & Sykova 1997, J Neurophysiol 78:912) divided by gray-matter tortuosity^2 with lambda ~ 1.55-1.60 (Hrabetova et al. 2018, J Neurosci 38:9355) gives D* ~ 5.1e-6 cm2/s. DECLARED SUBSTITUTION: no measured BCNU effective diffusivity in brain exists; the small-molecule TMA value stands in.
sources.k_clear_s: Bork et al. 2024, PNAS 121(16):e2318444121: the Groothuis replication of the efflux constant, about 5x faster, = 6.0e-4 /s, a difference the authors attribute to anaesthetic choice. HIGH end of a genuine 5x literature conflict; not rounding, so both ends are carried and every result is reported for both.
sources.molar_mass_g_mol: Carmustine C5H9Cl2N3O2, 214.05 g/mol (standard molecular formula and atomic masses; NOT from the grounding report). Only used to convert mg to umol.
sources.tick_seconds: Declared in config (v4.31 goal, Step A): a derived quantity, never implicit. Default 1800 s (30 min). The grounding report shows the tick is a trade-off, not a measurement: spread-per-tick and loss-per-tick cannot both be ~1 voxel / small.
sources.ticks: v4.1 world.yaml episode length (120 ticks); 60 h at the default 1800 s tick (v4.31 goal, Step A).
sources.voxel_mm: Perception store grid: store_adapter requires a 2.0 mm crop grid (v4.31 goal, Step A: 'from the perception store').
